name: Mystic Power (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Tovenaar magus archetype

Benefit: The tovenaar may expend one point from his arcane pool as a swift action to regain one expended use of an ability from an inquisition that has a limited number of uses per day.

Ultimate Options: New Magus Arcana Ultimate Options: New Magus Arcana. Copyright 2011, Super Genius Games, LLC; Author: Owen K.C. Stephens.
